name: implement
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the model-backed implement-then-PR doer (DESIGN §3.6.2/§3.6.3) replaces the dry-run reference adapter, or when the Handoff schema reaches a breaking major version.
spec_change_reason: Removed the now-dead rejected->close branch from the shipped implementer agent (v2.9.0->v2.10.0). Rejected orders never reach IMPLEMENT (PRIORITIZE fans out ACCEPTED-ONLY orders) and reject disposition (comment + rejected label, no close) moved to TRIAGE (work-intake gh_issue_reject_sink, wired by scheduling), so the doer now assumes an accepted order: implement -> worktree -> test-gate -> open PR with Closes #<n>, and reports only opened or blocked (never planned, no longer closed). Dropped the '## What to do' rejected branch, the defensive-reject note, every 'gh issue close' instruction, and the description's rejected->close capability. Kept the accept-path Closes-# keyword, the supersede-on-retry prior-PR close (a PR close, not an issue close), and the test-gate. src/implement.py: validate_handoff stays tolerant of a legacy 'closed' status (docstring updated; no code branch changed). contract.md 0.6.0->0.7.0 drops the 'gh issue close (reject path)' invoke. Housekeep doc baseline re-anchored in-scope (spec.md 353->355). spec.md was authored/committed by the dispatcher spec-update phase at 4b7d511.
